name: breadcrumb-23
description: Email client trail with an unread count on the folder and a truncated thread subject.

files.content:
import { MailIcon } from "lucide-react"

import { Badge } from "@workspace/ui/components/badge"
import {
  Breadcrumb,
  BreadcrumbItem,
  BreadcrumbLink,
  BreadcrumbList,
  BreadcrumbPage,
  BreadcrumbSeparator,
} from "@workspace/ui/components/breadcrumb"

export default function MailThreadBreadcrumb() {
  return (
    <Breadcrumb className="w-full max-w-sm">
      <BreadcrumbList className="flex-nowrap">
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbLink href="#" className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <MailIcon className="size-3.5" />
            Mail
          </BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator />
        <BreadcrumbItem>
          <BreadcrumbLink href="#" className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
            Inbox
            <Badge variant="secondary">14</Badge>
          </BreadcrumbLink>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
        <BreadcrumbSeparator />
        <BreadcrumbItem className="min-w-0">
          <BreadcrumbPage className="truncate">
            Re: Venue options for the November offsite
          </BreadcrumbPage>
        </BreadcrumbItem>
      </BreadcrumbList>
    </Breadcrumb>
  )
}
